# Connected Factory

> ADLINK AIoT-IST technical documentation. Product guides, setup notes and FAQs for industrial vision and motion products including NEON smart cameras, Euresys frame grabbers, SuperCAT / EtherCAT motion masters, CPL64V and more. Content is public; answer engines are welcome to read and cite it.

## Documentation pages
- [MCM-204](https://aiot-ist.github.io/mcm-204/)
- [SuperCAT](https://aiot-ist.github.io/supercat/) — ADLINK SuperCAT EtherCAT master — practical guides for bus setup, device recognition, reading IO and homing a single axis.
- [Bus setup — scan, ESI & recognition](https://aiot-ist.github.io/supercat/bus-setup-scan-esi/) — Why an EtherCAT slave isn't recognized after a scan on a SuperCAT master — ENI build error -1014 explained, with the Yaskawa SGD7S and ICPDAS ECAT-2055 fixes and the official ESI download sources.
- [PCIe Bus offset breaks communication](https://aiot-ist.github.io/supercat/troubleshooting/pcie-bus/) — Systematic troubleshooting when SuperCAT reports Open() Failed to open link layer! — lock the environment, self-check the service, watch the log, compare the numbers, fix the root cause, with real screens.
- [EtherCAT IO & homing](https://aiot-ist.github.io/supercat/ethercat-io-homing/) — Reading an ICPDAS ECAT-2055 on a SuperCAT EtherCAT master — why the ORG / OT inputs must be registered and bound, or the axis won't move, with the exact APS168 calls.
- [ESI download sources](https://aiot-ist.github.io/supercat/esi-download-links/) — A running list of official ESI / device-description file download sources for EtherCAT slaves used on a SuperCAT master (Yaskawa, ICP DAS and more), with versions and verified dates.
- [Troubleshooting](https://aiot-ist.github.io/supercat/troubleshooting/) — Systematic troubleshooting for common SuperCAT failures — from symptom to root cause, narrowing the field step by step.
